title: Default behavior of spark3.5.1 when writing Numeric/Bignumeric to BigQuery
question:
As per documentation of spark 3.5.1 using latest spark-bigquery-connector, Spark Decimal(38,0) should be written as Numeric in BigQuery.

https://github.com/GoogleCloudDataproc/spark-bigquery-connector?tab=readme-ov-file#numeric-and-bignumeric-support

But when testing, its trying to write as BigNumeric.

The same is happening till Decimal(30,0). Spark is trying to write as BigNumeric instead of Numeric.

When Decimal(29,0) is used, Spark is writing as Numeric to BigQuery.

Using 2.2.40-ubuntu22 version of dataproc GCP.

Decimal(38,0) is correctly being written to BIgQuery as Numeric if below jar file is being used.

gs://spark-lib/bigquery/spark-bigquery-with-dependencies_2.12-0.23.2.jar

But when no jar file is used, spark is using default jar file of image 2.2.40-ubuntu22 causing discrepancies like trying to write decimal(38,0) as Bignumeric instead of Numeric.
answer: According to BigQuery's Parameterized decimal type documentation, the maximum precision cannot be more than (SCALE + 29). Therefore, if the scale is 0, the max precision is 29. A DECIMAL(30,0) should be mapped then to the BIGNUMERIC type.
